full_judgment: 10. I have heard the learned Advocate and perused the judgment of the courts below on perusal of the judgment of the appellate court. I find that the lower appellate court as a final court of fact has neither discussed nor considered the oral and documentary evidence while reversing the findings and decisions of the trial court. The provision of Order 41 Rule 31 of the Code of Civil Procedure enjoins that either reversing or affirming the decision of the trial court it is incumbent upon the appellate court as a final court of fact to consider, assess both oral and documentary evidence in order to come to his own independent finding particularly when it reversal the finding of the trial court. The appellate court in the instant case having failed to comply with the aforesaid mandatory provision of law committed a gross error of law and the judgment and decree of the appellate court cannot be sustained in law. Since the judgment of the appellate court does not reflect as to how it considered the materials on record to reverse the findings of the trial court, I find substance in the contention of Mr. Sultan Ahmed and set aside the judgment and decree of the appellate court.
